WARNING: TEST ONLY. Every private key here is published on purpose. Never use one for a real device or vault.
about: verify_notice(notice bytes, watch, folder keyring bytes) for every case. The removed device is C, trusted epoch 1. 'expected.reason' is the RemovalError reason, null when accepted. See tests/vectors/sync/README.md 'Removal notices'.
